one_line: Anthropic secures massive power generation, midterm elections reshape data center politics, and AI music platforms face major lawsuits.

themes.title: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas generators
themes.text: Anthropic purchased commitments for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators from equipment supplier OnePWR for $3.4 billion, marking the largest known purchase of gas-fired generators by an AI lab.

stories.headline: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas-fired generators in $3.4B deal

themes.title: Midterm elections reshape data center politics
themes.text: Democrats won a historic victory in the midterm elections, leading to voter rejection of data centers and mixed results for political action committees backed by AI interests.

stories.headline: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
Anthropic-backed PAC Public First spent $63M+ in 2026 midterms
Pro-AI super PAC network Leading the Future falls short in midterms

themes.title: Music estates sue Suno over cloning
themes.text: Elvis Presley Enterprises and Eminem publisher Eight Mile Style filed lawsuits against AI music company Suno over copyright infringement and unauthorized voice cloning.

stories.headline: Elvis Presley estate sues Suno over voice cloning and copyright infringement
Elvis and Eminem rights holders file lawsuits against AI music platform Suno

themes.title: Claude Code exposes credentials on GitHub
themes.text: Apiiro researchers found that Claude Code's settings feature can store database passwords and other credentials in local files that are then committed to public GitHub repositories.

stories.headline: Claude Code approval files expose company secrets on GitHub
